title: Chord sets of twelve, with smooth changes
thisBuild: Every chord set now has 12 chords, one rooted on every key of the octave: press E and you get an E chord, in every octave. The Padiano's chord boxes show all 12.

Smooth moves (on out of the box): each chord picks the inversion nearest the last one you played, so a change glides instead of jumping up and down. The Key tray has the switch (Smooth moves or From the root).
Four new sets: Plain Major, Plain Minor, Lo-fi Jazz and Cinematic. The old eight are rewritten to twelve chords each, with no doubled roots.
Picking a set no longer moves your scale: sets follow the key's root only.
watch: Play Sunday Pop or Neo Soul on the chord boxes: do the changes feel smoother now?
Any set where a chord on a black key sounds wrong to you? Tell me which set and key.
Switch to From the root and back: is Smooth the right default?
limits: The Roll still writes chords from their root, so what it draws matches the rows you tap.
Making your own sets isn't in yet.
The cut and look changes are still proposals: nothing moved on screen in this build.
